If you'd like more information on this data, what we do with it, and more granular controls, please take a look at our Privacy Settings.I AgreeJohn Glenn Columbus International AirportPart of Columbus Regional Airport Authority (CRAA)IATA: CMHICAO: KCMHCity: Columbus, OHCountry/Territory: United States of AmericaJohn Glenn Columbus International AirportAddress: 4600 International Gateway, Columbus, OH 43219, United States of AmericaRunways3,086m × 46m2,438m × 46mAboutJohn Glenn Columbus International Airport (formerly known as Port Columbus International Airport) is an international airport located 6 miles (10 kilometres) east of downtown Columbus, Ohio, USA. It is managed by the Columbus Regional Airport Authority, which also oversees operations at Rickenbacker International Airport. The airport is primarily a passenger airport, providing commercial air service to most major airport hubs across the United States. The airport is the largest passenger airport in the central Ohio region and is the second busiest in the state after Cleveland Hopkins International Airport.Ground/Cargo Handlers and Caterers servicing John Glenn Columbus International AirportAmerican AirlinesDelta Air LinesSignature Flight SupportFuel & Oil Suppliers servicing John Glenn Columbus International AirportWorld Fuel ServicesCAPA ProfilesCAPA Profiles help you identify new business opportunities and make better business decisions, by providing accurate and up-to-date data on airports, airlines, suppliers, investors, MROs, lessors and countries/territories around the world.
